verdict.rationale: Keycloak is self-hosted software that can be run via Docker/container images against a database the operator chooses (e.g., PostgreSQL), which inherently lets an operator pick the physical region/infrastructure for data storage. However, there is no explicit documentation addressing data residency, region selection, or compliance controls as a named feature. Missing for 10: explicit residency/region documentation, multi-region deployment guidance, data localization/compliance statements.
